summary: Mother is an open hand with the thumb tapping the chin. The chin is the female location in ASL family signs.
steps: Spread your fingers in an open hand.
Tap the thumb against your chin twice.
For GRANDMOTHER, do the same and then bounce the hand forward in two small arcs.
note: Female family signs sit at the chin; male ones sit at the forehead. MOTHER and FATHER are identical except for location. Learn them as a pair.
mistakes: Using a closed hand. The fingers are spread.

faq.a: Same sign. MOTHER and MOM are not distinguished in ASL. Some signers tap once for a quick casual version.
